name: vitepress-plugin-open-in-editor-monorepo
description: Monorepo for vitepress-plugin-open-in-editor and its framework-agnostic editor-detection core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w open-in-editor-core && npm run build -w vitepress-plugin-open-in-editor
scripts.build:types: npm run build:types -w open-in-editor-core && npm run build:types -w vitepress-plugin-open-in-editor
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:types
